fields.query_param_normalization: single value via searchParams.get('host'); no validation at prefill (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:240); trimmed by zod on submit
client_only_validation: non-empty after trim ('Host is required'); schema has no minLength

fields.label: PKey
fields.schema_description: Partition key whose members will be removed.
fields.query_param_normalization: single value via searchParams.get('pkey'); no validation at prefill (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:241)
client_only_validation: regex ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}$ ('PKey must match 0x + 1-4 hex digits (e.g. 0x8001)'); same rule as the server field_validator (_ib_pkey_helpers.py:60-68) but absent from JSON Schema (no pattern)
fields.submit_transform: zod .trim(); not canonicalized client-side (server field_validator canonicalizes to 0x%04x)

fields.name: input_mode
fields.label: Member Source

options.notes: UI-only discriminator; radio labels 'By Interfaces' / 'By GUIDs' (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:343-369)

fields.submit_transform: UI-only; never sent. Selects which branch (interfaces, or guids) is serialized; the other branch's rows stay in form state but are omitted.

fields.name: interfaces
fields.schema_type: array[$ref InterfaceRef {device: string (required), interface: string (required), membership: anyOf[string, null] default null}]
fields.label: Interfaces
fields.schema_description: DCIM interfaces to resolve to InfiniBand port GUIDs.
fields.widget_today: field-array rows: input device (placeholder 'device (e.g. hca01)') + input interface (placeholder 'interface (e.g. mlx5_0)'); 'Add Row' button, trash button per row (disabled when one row remains)
client_only_validation: at least one row with both device and interface ('Add at least one device/interface row')
half-filled row: device without interface -> 'Interface name is required'; interface without device -> 'Device name is required'
fields.submit_transform: sent only when input_mode == 'interfaces'; rows filtered to non-empty (trimmed) device AND interface and mapped to {device, interface} (membership never sent); key omitted in GUID mode (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:282-293)

fields.name: guids
fields.label: GUIDs
fields.description: One GUID per row. Each must match 0x + 16 hex digits.
fields.schema_description: InfiniBand port GUIDs to remove directly from the partition.
fields.widget_today: field-array rows: input guid (aria-label 'GUID N', placeholder '0x0011223344556677'); 'Add Row' button, trash button per row (disabled when one row remains)
client_only_validation: at least one non-empty GUID row ('Provide at least one GUID')
each GUID matches ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{16}$ ('Invalid GUID. Expected 0x + 16 hex digits.'); no schema pattern and no model validator
fields.submit_transform: sent only when input_mode == 'guids'; non-empty trimmed guid strings from the rows (row objects flattened to string[]); key omitted in interfaces mode (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:294-296)

payload_transform: body = {host, pkey} (zod-trimmed). input_mode == 'interfaces' -> body.interfaces = rows with non-empty device and interface mapped to {device, interface} (no membership); input_mode == 'guids' -> body.guids = non-empty guid strings. The inactive branch key is omitted; input_mode is never sent (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:275-300). startWorkflow POSTs to /v1/workflow/ngc/ib_pkey_member_delete; 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id}; on error a destructive 'Workflow Failed' toast is shown and the submit button re-enabled (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:302-309, ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184).
discrepancies: pkey: UI regex and the server field_validator agree on ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}$ (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/_ib_pkey_helpers.py:60-68) but JSON Schema has no pattern; the server canonicalizes to 0x%04x while the UI submits the trimmed raw value.
GUID format ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{16}$ is client-only (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:55,138-145); no schema pattern or model validator.

interfaces XOR guids is enforced by the model_validator (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/_ib_pkey_helpers.py:71-93), not by JSON Schema (both default []); the UI guarantees it via the mode switch and by omitting the inactive branch.
Fully empty rows are silently dropped before POST; half-filled interface rows block submit client-side.
The MSW mock rejects malformed GUIDs and pkeys at POST (ui/src/mocks/handlers/ibPkeyMemberHandlers.ts:35-36,60-63,84-86); the real model validates pkey format but has no GUID format check.
Labels differ from schema titles ('UFM Host'/'Host', 'PKey'/'Pkey', 'GUIDs'/'Guids'); schema descriptions are not displayed.
Every top-level IBPKeyMemberDeleteInput field is reachable from the UI; the nested InterfaceRef.membership is never sent by this form.
e2e coverage (ui/tests/e2e/ibPkeyMemberDeleteForm.spec.ts) only exercises interfaces mode; GUID mode and URL prefill are untested for this slug.
contract_gaps: interfaces is an array of $ref objects (list[InterfaceRef]); the generic renderer has no row/array-of-object editor and rejects nested editable arrays.
input_mode is a UI-only discriminator, not a model field; visible_if.field must reference a sibling model field, so the interfaces/GUIDs switch cannot be expressed. Only op 'equals' would be needed.
The legacy form omits the inactive branch. Sending the default [] still passes the server XOR but breaks byte-identical parity; sending stale rows from the other mode fails the XOR.
No radio widget in the v1 vocabulary (select is the nearest).

One shared component serves add/update/delete with per-workflow props (title, submitLabel, includeMembershipType, destructiveWarning); ui_component is a bare string, so either three registry keys or an adapter keyed on the workflow name is needed.
